summary: A reply to a request for a document now says when no document was saved, instead of claiming it was made.
details: When Nora called the document tool and nothing was stored, her reply ends with "(No document was saved.)".
The rules for writing a document are in one place (the catalog she reads before she writes), and she gets two more tries after a refusal.
limitations: She can still write that a document was made; the note is added beside it, not instead of it.
Whether she now publishes after reading the catalog is measured by a live read-back, not an eval.
